This is where I'll post short, informal notes — a neat result from a
simulation, a debugging story, a paper I liked and why, conference
takeaways. Nothing here is peer-reviewed; treat it as a lab notebook, not
a publication.

For the group's actual publications, CV, and research overview, see the
[main lab site](https://giuseppetorri.com).

A quick example of embedding code and a figure directly in a post:

```{python}
#| label: fig-example
#| fig-cap: "A placeholder sine wave — swap for real model output."
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 4 * np.pi, 200)
plt.plot(x, np.sin(x))
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("sin(x)")
plt.show()
```
